name: Breaker spring-charging motor circuit
summary: Supplies the motor that restores the documented stored-energy closing mechanism.
description: Supplies the motor that restores the documented stored-energy closing mechanism. A stored-energy breaker mechanism has charging, release, indication and supervision functions. Motor supply, stored spring energy and the ability to complete an opening operation are separate drawing concerns.

In a switchgear panel, a charging motor replenishes the mechanism after an operation. Supervisory contacts let the controller report an incomplete charge or repeated charging demand before an operator requests another operation. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charging demand and motor supply” at the input and “Spring charging action” at the output. Motor operation differs from closing-coil operation.

Show the individual contacts and the relevant motor or release circuit. Supply voltage, charging time, operating duty and permissible alarms must follow the chosen mechanism documentation. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
